headline: Govt employees to get 3 months' arrears together
summary: The payments will be disbursed along with October salaries following the implementation of a new pay scale.
details: Government officials and employees will receive approximately three months of salary arrears in a single payment under the new pay structure.
The exact amount each individual receives will depend on their specific pay fixation process.
The Finance Division of the Ministry of Finance has directed that the pay fixation process begin this Monday.
The ministry has set a deadline of October 20 to complete all necessary calculations and administrative work.
caption:
Three months of back pay coming soon for government employees!

Government officials and employees will receive approximately three months of salary arrears in a single payment under the new pay structure.

The exact amount each individual receives will depend on their specific pay fixation process.

The Finance Division of the Ministry of Finance has directed that the pay fixation process begin this Monday.

The ministry has set a deadline of October 20 to complete all necessary calculations and administrative work.

Source: Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Army chief [[visits Australia and US]] on 9-day official tour
headline: Army chief visits Australia and US on 9-day official tour
summary: General Waker-uz-Zaman departs Dhaka to attend key defense symposiums and meet high-ranking military officials in both nations.
details: Bangladesh Army Chief General Waker-uz-Zaman has left Dhaka for a nine-day official visit to Australia and the United States.
In Australia, he will participate in 'The Chief of Army Symposium and Land Forces International Defence Exposition-2026' in Perth and visit Deakin University in Melbourne.
Following the Australia leg, General Waker-uz-Zaman will travel to Washington D.C. to attend the 'Association of the US Army (AUSA) Annual Meeting and Exposition'.
During the tour, the Army Chief will hold courtesy meetings and exchange views with key defense officials from both Australia and the US.
He is also scheduled to visit various military installations in both countries as part of his official itinerary.
caption:
Army Chief General Waker-uz-Zaman begins a 9-day official tour of Australia and the US to strengthen defense ties.

Bangladesh Army Chief General Waker-uz-Zaman has left Dhaka for a nine-day official visit to Australia and the United States.

In Australia, he will participate in 'The Chief of Army Symposium and Land Forces International Defence Exposition-2026' in Perth and visit Deakin University in Melbourne.

Following the Australia leg, General Waker-uz-Zaman will travel to Washington D.C. to attend the 'Association of the US Army (AUSA) Annual Meeting and Exposition'.

During the tour, the Army Chief will hold courtesy meetings and exchange views with key defense officials from both Australia and the US.

He is also scheduled to visit various military installations in both countries as part of his official itinerary.

#Bangladesh #ArmyChief #Defense #Diplomacy #Australia #USA

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune
